task_request: SaaS enterprise feature gap analysis: identify and prioritize missing capabilities vs. three major competitors

plan.summary: competitive feature research then prioritized roadmap

phases.objective: map feature parity against three primary competitors across all modules
rank missing features by customer impact and development complexity

GROW.content:
# Enterprise SaaS Feature Comparison

Competitor A: 87 features in core modules, SSO not bundled
Competitor B: 94 features, includes advanced audit trail
Competitor C: 72 features, focuses on ease of use over breadth

Gap analysis reveals 12 high-priority missing features across reporting and security modules.
GROW.summary: Mapped feature gaps against three enterprise SaaS competitors.

FRAME.content:
# Enterprise Feature Roadmap

## P1 Features (Q3-Q4)
1. Advanced audit trail (per https://example.com/verified-competitor-features)
2. Custom SAML/SSO endpoints
3. Role-based API scoping

## P2 Features (Q1 2027)
1. Granular export controls
2. Real-time collaboration features
3. Enhanced reporting dashboards

Implementation prioritizes revenue impact and competitive differentiation.
FRAME.summary: Prioritized enterprise feature roadmap based on competitive analysis.
